title: Technology Sector Update for 10/09/2018: ZNGA,EBAY,TSEM,BLKB

Technology stocks have turned moderately higher in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were adding almost 0.6% in value today while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising nearly 0.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Zynga raced as much as 13% higher and its trading volume Tuesday was running more than four times its average daily volume amid speculation the online gaming is attracting takeover interest from some of its larger rivals. Bloomberg said the company already has received an acquisition offer from an unidentified "gaming suitor." The company declined comment when contacted by CNBC television about the buyout rumors.
In other sector news:
(+) eBay ( EBAY ) traded as much as 6% higher on Tuesday amid unconfirmed market speculation activist investor Carl Icahn is taking a stake in the online auctions and sales company.
(+) Tower Semiconductor ( TSEM ) climbed over 6% at one point on Tuesday after analysts at Jefferies & Co began coverage of the Israeli chipmaker specializing in analog and mixed-signal semiconductor devices with a Buy investment recommendation.
(-) Blackbaud ( BLKB ) tumbled to a 20-month low on Tuesday, sliding almost 23% to its lowest share price since January 2017 at $69.62 each after the cloud software company cut its adjuted FY18 earning and revenue outlooks. Excluding one-time items, Blackbaud is now expecting non-GAAP net income in a range of $2.46 to $2.52 per share on between $844 million to $854 million in revenue, lagging the Capital IQ consensus by at least $0.25 per share and $16.4 million, respectively.
